xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3184: Boot reconciliation latches hold_all over an empty candidate set — fleet parks silently, banner self-hides, resume_all resumes nothing

plan.title: Boot reconciliation latches hold_all over an empty candidate set — fleet parks silently, banner self-hides, resume_all resumes nothing
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

references.label: PAN-3183 (companion: rogue boot-path batch-stop writer, out of scope)

narratives.Problem: After the 2026-07-27 reboot the entire stopped fleet (6 strikes + 1 work agent) silently stayed down with no popup or banner. Verified chain: isBootReconciliationCandidate excluded the whole cohort (strikes by the role!=='work' gate at boot-reconciliation.ts:102, the work agent by the stoppedByUser exclusion at line 104) even though all stops were 39s before the stamp, inside the 240s recency window. The grace timer then latched hold_all unconditionally over the empty set (line 217). The event-path hold (deacon-auto-resume.ts:658) parked every later stopped-agent event — a broader set than candidates. The banner derived its visibility from the empty candidate set and self-hid (BootReconciliationModal.tsx:338). resume_all applied to the empty live candidate list and resumed nothing; even a non-empty list would have refused the cohort (stoppedByUser refusal at deacon-auto-resume.ts:742, role gate at :639).
narratives.Proposal: Widen candidacy to the recently-stopped cohort (admit role 'strike' via a shared isAutoResumableRole helper; delete the stoppedByUser exclusion — recency is the sole discriminator). Never latch a vacuous hold: empty live candidate set at grace expiry resolves resume_all. Classify the boot: handleShutdownSignal persists dashboard.last_clean_shutdown_at synchronously at entry; expiry over non-empty candidates commits resume_all on a clean boot (marker within 30 min) and hold_all on a crash/unknown boot. Make apply origin-aware: the automatic expiry default filters stoppedByUser candidates out, while an explicit operator resume_all resumes the full held cohort via a new overrideStoppedByUser option on handleAgentStoppedEvent. Serve a live heldCount from GET /api/boot-reconciliation and drive the held banner from it. Amends the resolved 'expiry = Hold' decision in docs/FAILSAFE-CONTROL-ARCHITECTURE.md:85.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Identifying or fixing the 02:52:14Z batch-stop writer (that is PAN-3183)
- Widening the steady-state patrol (autoResumeStoppedWorkAgents, deacon-auto-resume.ts:866-867) to strikes
- A server-side dashboard-client gauge / holding the grace window while zero clients are connected (no client count exists; shutdown classification chosen instead)
- Read-model vs agents-table drift / phantom running agents (PAN-3183)
- CLI parity pan boot status (PAN-2078)
- Any change to OVERDECK_NO_RESUME handling or the Freeze control
- New config keys (classification constants are exported code constants)

autoDecisions.summary: D1: deleted the stoppedByUser candidacy exclusion outright; recency is the sole discriminator between boot-caused and historical deliberate stops
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-3183 proved stoppedByUser attribution near boot is written by an untrusted pre-deacon writer; the boot dialog exists to let the operator disposition exactly this cohort, and out-of-window deliberate stops are still excluded by the recency check.

autoDecisions.summary: D2: strikes admitted to boot candidacy and the handleAgentStoppedEvent role gate via one isAutoResumableRole helper; steady-state patrol NOT widened
autoDecisions.rationale: The incident fleet was 6/7 strikes and the operator expected them auto-resumed; resumeAgent is role-agnostic and kickoff delivery already treats work/strike alike. The patrol stays work-only to avoid resurrecting historical stopped strikes outside a boot.

autoDecisions.summary: D3: automatic expiry default filters stoppedByUser candidates; explicit operator resume_all overrides via overrideStoppedByUser
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps 'pan stop-all-agents' + reboot safe (auto path never resurrects deliberate stops) while making the banner's Resume-all actually reach the incident cohort; an explicit click is an informed override.

autoDecisions.summary: D4: clean-vs-crash shutdown classification chosen over the issue's zero-dashboard-clients hold-open alternative
autoDecisions.rationale: ws-rpc keeps no global dashboard-client count, so 'zero clients' is not implementable without new substrate; a persisted last-clean-shutdown marker written synchronously at handleShutdownSignal entry covers the same operator-latency gap (clean reboot auto-resumes, crash boot holds and shows the banner).

autoDecisions.summary: D5: banner visibility driven by a server-computed live heldCount rather than a client-side filter of data.set
autoDecisions.rationale: One live definition of 'held' (listBootReconciliationCandidates) feeds the route set, heldCount, and the apply batch, so the banner can never again hide while the hold suppresses resumes.

items.title: Admit strikes and the in-window stoppedByUser cohort to boot candidacy

expected_outputs: boot-reconciliation test suite passes including new strike and stoppedByUser candidacy cases

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/boot-reconciliation.ts: (1) add and export `isAutoResumableRole(role)` returning true for 'work' and 'strike'; (2) in isBootReconciliationCandidate (line 101) replace the `agent.role !== 'work'` check with `!isAutoResumableRole(agent.role)`; (3) DELETE the stoppedByUser exclusion at line 104 and the now-unused hasCompletionMarker function (lines 64-68) — decision D1: recency (isRecentBootCandidate, line 105) is the sole discriminator. In src/lib/cloister/deacon-auto-resume.ts: replace the role gate at line 639 (`state.role !== 'work'`) with `!isAutoResumableRole(state.role)`, importing the helper from boot-reconciliation.js and keeping the log line's role interpolation. Do NOT widen the patrol query at deacon-auto-resume.ts:866-867 (NonGoal). Tests in src/lib/cloister/__tests__/boot-reconciliation.test.ts (follow the existing vi.hoisted/vi.mock pattern): a stopped strike agent with live workspace and open issue is a candidate; an in-window stoppedByUser work agent is a candidate; the same stoppedByUser agent with a stop older than max-candidate-age is rejected; a paused strike is rejected.

isBootReconciliationCandidate returns true for a stopped work agent with stoppedByUser=true stopped inside the boot window, and returns false for the same agent whose newest timestamp is older than bootStartedAt minus max-candidate-age
handleAgentStoppedEvent no longer logs 'role=strike (not work)' for a stopped strike — the role gate accepts work and strike via isAutoResumableRole

Resolve resume_all instead of hold_all when the candidate set is empty at grace expiry

expected_outputs: new fake-timer test shows expiry over an empty candidate set commits resume_all and logs the vacuous-release line

narrative.Action: In armBootReconciliationGraceTimer's expiry callback (src/lib/cloister/boot-reconciliation.ts:214-223): after the `decision !== 'pending'` guard and BEFORE committing any decision, compute `listBootReconciliationCandidateIds().length`; when 0, call setBootReconciliationDecision('resume_all'), log `boot reconciliation grace expired — vacuous hold auto-released (0 candidates)` via logDeaconEventSync, invoke the onGraceExpired hook with the same catch-log pattern as today, and return. Test with vi.useFakeTimers (repo rule — never real setTimeout): stamp a boot with zero candidates, advance past the deadline, assert getBootReconciliationState().decision === 'resume_all' and the vacuous-release log line was emitted.

items.title: With zero live candidates at expiry, the committed decision is resume_all (not hold_all) and the deacon log contains 'vacuous hold auto-released'

Persist dashboard.last_clean_shutdown_at synchronously at shutdown-signal entry

expected_outputs: typecheck and lint pass; marker helpers exported from control-settings.ts; marker write is the first statement after the shuttingDown guard in handleShutdownSignal

narrative.Action: In src/lib/overdeck/control-settings.ts add `export const DASHBOARD_LAST_CLEAN_SHUTDOWN_AT_KEY = 'dashboard.last_clean_shutdown_at';` plus `getLastCleanShutdownAt(): string | null` and `setLastCleanShutdownAt(iso: string): void` built on the existing getSetting/setSetting helpers (NFR-2 — no new store access). In src/dashboard/server/main.ts handleShutdownSignal (line 627): immediately after `shuttingDown = true;` and BEFORE broadcastServerRestarting() and any await (NFR-3), call setLastCleanShutdownAt(new Date().toISOString()) wrapped in try/catch that console.warns on failure (non-fatal). No other reordering of the shutdown sequence.

Classify the boot: clean shutdown expires to resume_all, crash boot to hold_all

expected_outputs: updated locked test asserts hold_all only in the no-marker (crash) case; new tests assert resume_all with a fresh marker and hold_all with a stale marker

narrative.Action: Depends on vacuous-hold-auto-release and clean-shutdown-marker. In src/lib/cloister/boot-reconciliation.ts: (1) add `export const CLEAN_SHUTDOWN_FRESHNESS_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;` and `export function isCleanShutdownBoot(now: Date = new Date()): boolean` — true only when getLastCleanShutdownAt() (from control-settings.js) parses and `now.getTime() - Date.parse(marker) <= CLEAN_SHUTDOWN_FRESHNESS_MS`; (2) in the expiry callback, AFTER the vacuous-hold check, commit `isCleanShutdownBoot() ? 'resume_all' : 'hold_all'` and log which classification fired, e.g. `boot reconciliation grace expired — clean shutdown within 30m, decision set to resume_all` or `… — no clean shutdown marker (crash boot), decision set to hold_all`. Tests (fake timers; mock getLastCleanShutdownAt in the existing control-settings vi.mock): UPDATE the locked test 'stamps pending state and flips to hold_all when the grace timer expires' (line ~360) to cover the crash case (marker null); ADD marker-5-min-old + non-empty candidates → resume_all; marker-45-min-old → hold_all. Note: with a non-empty candidate set the expiry path must call the candidate-list function AFTER the vacuous check, so order the tests' mock agents accordingly.

items.title: With getLastCleanShutdownAt() 5 minutes before boot and a non-empty candidate set, expiry commits resume_all and logs the clean-shutdown classification
With no marker (or a marker 45 minutes old) and a non-empty candidate set, expiry commits hold_all and logs the crash-boot classification
The pre-existing grace-expiry test covers the no-marker crash case (edited in place, not deleted), and the full boot-reconciliation suite passes under fake timers
Origin-aware apply: auto default skips stoppedByUser, operator resume_all overrides it

expected_outputs: new apply test file passes: auto origin drops stoppedByUser candidates, operator origin forwards overrideStoppedByUser:true, hold_all no-ops

narrative.Action: Depends on widen-candidacy. (1) src/lib/cloister/deacon-auto-resume.ts: add `overrideStoppedByUser?: boolean` to HandleAgentStoppedOptions (line ~612); in the deliberate-stop refusal (lines 742-746) skip the refusal when opts.overrideStoppedByUser === true (log `resuming despite stoppedByUser — explicit operator resume_all override`). (2) src/lib/cloister/boot-reconciliation-apply.ts: change the signature to `applyBootReconciliationDecision(deps, opts?: { origin?: 'operator' | 'auto' })` with default origin 'auto'; when auto, filter the candidate list to `agent.stoppedByUser !== true` right after listBootReconciliationCandidates() (line 58) and log how many were filtered; when operator, pass `overrideStoppedByUser: true` in the handleAgentStoppedEvent options (line 103, alongside skipGlobalGates/context). (3) src/dashboard/server/main.ts:799 keeps calling the expiry hook with no opts (auto). (4) src/dashboard/server/routes/boot-reconciliation.ts:144 passes `{ origin: 'operator' }` as the second argument — check the actual first-argument (deps) shape at that call site and preserve it exactly. (5) NEW test file src/lib/cloister/__tests__/boot-reconciliation-apply.test.ts modeled on the vi.hoisted + vi.mock pattern of boot-reconciliation.test.ts: mock boot-reconciliation.js (candidate list), deacon-auto-resume.js (handleAgentStoppedEvent spy), concurrency.js, memory-governor.js, control-settings.js, tmux.js. Cases: auto origin over [stoppedByUser agent, plain agent] calls handleAgentStoppedEvent only for the plain one; operator origin calls it for both with overrideStoppedByUser:true; decision hold_all returns the empty result and never calls handleAgentStoppedEvent.
